_comment: GENERATED by `make sync-registry` from script/DeployConstants.sol. Do not hand-edit: a CI test re-derives every row and fails if this file diverges. To change a deployment, edit DeployConstants (label, wallet factory, chain lists) and re-run sync. The 'omnibus' field is predictOmnibus(version), pure offline math. The 'deployed' field is the one field that cannot be derived (a CREATE3 address is predictable whether or not anything was deployed to it) and is refreshed per-chain by running sync with that chain rpc-url.
